For a 30-day trip, a Seychellois passport holder will need to get a Vietnam e-Visa — the visa-free allowance for Seychelles only covers stays up to 14 days, and your 30-day trip exceeds that.

Details on the e-Visa:
- Valid for stays of up to 90 days
- Cost: USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry)
- Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Processing takes about 2-3 business days (expedited options available at extra cost)
- Usable for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date

This is based on data as of 2026-08-17 — I'd recommend double-checking current policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
